title: CLI main() test coverage: ConfigError branch + entrypoint guard
description: cck.6 code review (Important): packages/cli/test/cli.test.ts only covers buildBanner. main()'s ConfigError branch (process.exitCode=1 + stderr), the happy-path stdout, and the import.meta.url entrypoint guard are untested. Proper coverage needs vi.spyOn on console.error/process.exitCode for the ConfigError path, and either a child-process spawn harness or a createMain(env?) factory refactor (mirroring loadConfig(env)) to make the guard/main fully unit-testable. Beyond E0 thin-CLI scope and the spec's required test; track separately.
